stem: Why did the story of sexual abuse come to light in the case of the young boy with palatal damage?

options.text: The boy's parents suspected it and told the dentist
The dentist performed a routine check and asked about the injury
The uncle confessed during the dental appointment
The child had visible bruising on his external cheeks

explanation: It was only because the practitioner routinely checked the whole mouth and questioned the damage that the child felt able to tell the story.
rationale: Consider the importance of the practitioner's thoroughness and direct communication with the patient.

optionExplanations.A: The text notes that these issues can be difficult to pursue within families, implying the family did not initiate the report.
optionExplanations.B: It was only because the practitioner routinely checked the whole mouth and questioned the damage that the child felt able to tell the story.
optionExplanations.C: The text indicates the story came from the child after being asked by the dental practitioner.
optionExplanations.D: While bruising was mentioned in another case, the discovery here was specifically linked to the examination of the palate.
